p01.sspecial: dashes forward very low and fast, then spins around on the spot and swings his elbow back behind him, then turns back into the stance; nothing leaves his body, his hands stay empty
p01.uair: in mid-air, sweeps one open hand up in an arc over his head, then back to the tucked pose; nothing leaves his body, his hands stay empty
p01.dair: in mid-air, extends one leg straight down below him heel first, then pulls the leg back up; nothing leaves his body
p01.fsmash: silat double palm push: sinks low drawing both hands back to the hip, then steps forward and pushes both open palms straight ahead at chest height, then recovers; nothing leaves his hands, his hands stay empty
p01.grab: lunges forward and reaches out with both open hands, closes them on empty air, then pulls back; nothing leaves his hands
p01.fthrow: holding an invisible opponent, steps forward and pushes both hands forward, then returns to the fighting stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; nothing leaves his hands
p01.bthrow: pivots on the spot, turning his back to the right for a moment with both arms swinging close to his body, then turns back into the fighting stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; his hands stay empty, nothing leaves them, no beam, no streak
p01.dthrow: holding an invisible opponent, crouches and brings both hands down to the floor in front of him, then rises back into the fighting stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; nothing leaves his hands
p01.w1_dthrow: holding an invisible opponent, crouches and brings his free hand down to the floor in front of him, then points both curved violet daggers down at the floor, then returns to the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; nothing comes out of the floor or the daggers
p01.w1_dspecial: kneels down on one knee with both curved violet daggers held low at his sides, then stands back up; nothing comes out of the floor or the daggers

p02.knockdown: tips slowly backwards off balance and sinks down until she lies flat on her back on the floor, ending lying still; nothing else is drawn around her
p02.ledgeattack: rises from a low crouch with a quick low sweeping kick forward, then back into the fighting stance; her foot passes just above the floor, nothing is kicked up
p02.w0_knockdown: tips slowly backwards off balance and sinks down until she lies flat on her back on the floor, still holding her spear, ending lying still; nothing else is drawn around her
p02.w0_grab: leans forward and reaches out with her free open hand, closes it on empty air, then pulls back, the other hand keeping a long silver spear with white ribbons still at her side. The whole weapon stays inside the picture; nothing leaves her hands
p02.w0_sspecial: runs forward with the spear held out in front, then slows down and stops in the stance; her feet stay light on the floor, nothing is kicked up
p02.w0_dthrow: holding an invisible opponent low with her free hand, lifts the spear high, then lowers its tip slowly toward the floor in front of her, then returns to the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; the spear tip never touches the floor, nothing comes out of the floor
p02.w1_holdstart: keeps a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons upright in the hand on her right side and stretches her other arm straight out to the right at shoulder height, across in front of her chest, the open hand closing on the collar of an invisible opponent standing to her right; ends with that arm fully extended to the right, holding it at arm's length, staying in side profile facing right the whole time. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame

p03.dspecial: crouches and presses both fists down onto the floor in front of him, then stands back up; nothing comes out of the floor or his fists
p03.dair: in mid-air, brings both elbows down beneath him, then back to the tucked pose; nothing is drawn below him
